Bill.BriefDescription: Revising reporting requirements for income and resources under the public assistance program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to income and resources reporting requirementsunder the public assistance program; and amending RCW 74.04.300.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 74.04.300 and 1998 c 79 s 7 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: If a recipient receives public assistance and/or food stamps orfood stamp benefits transferred electronically for which the recipientis not eligible, or receives public assistance and/or food stamps orfood stamp benefits transferred electronically in an amount greaterthan that for which the recipient is eligible, the portion of thepayment to which the recipient is not entitled shall be a debt due thestate recoverable under RCW 43.20B.030 and 43.20B.620 through43.20B.645. ((It shall be the duty of)) The department may by ruledetermine reporting requirements for recipients of public assistanceand/or food stamps or food stamp benefits transferred electronically tonotify the department ((within twenty days)) of the receipt orpossession of ((all)) countable income or resources not previouslydeclared to the department. The rules shall be consistent with federallaw and regulations governing public assistance programs. The p. 1 HB 1635department shall advise applicants for assistance that failure toreport as required, failure to reveal resources or income, and falsestatements will result in recovery by the state of any overpayment andmay result in criminal prosecution.
